data.name: Phyllis Kamrin
data.rate: $100 per hour per group; an hour and a half coaching would be $150 for the group.
data.introduction: I graduated many years ago from the Curtis Institute of Music.  Since then I have played with many groups and organizations. Notably, I played with Philharmonia Baroque Orchestra, New Century Chamber Orchestra, and now have my musical home with the Left Coast Chamber Ensemble, where I perform both new and old chamber music. I love coaching less advanced ensembles as it is astounding to hear the progress throughout the sessions and into the performance!  I also ran the Crowden Adult Chamber Music program from 2014-2025 and watched it blossom into a wonderful community of musicians and coaches.
